claims.statement: Using exact whole-number physics, one game blueprint replays identically for hours across Windows, macOS, Linux, and major engines.
Standard decimal math drifts across operating systems within thirty-seven frames, and chaotic collisions quickly amplify tiny rounding gaps.

easy_read.easy_title: Write One Game That Replays Everywhere
three_points_one_idea_sentences: This study is about write one game that replays everywhere.
Using exact whole-number physics, one game blueprint replays identically for hours across Windows, macOS, Linux, and major engines.
Standard decimal math drifts across operating systems within thirty-seven frames, and chaotic collisions quickly amplify tiny rounding gaps.
Graphics cards vary slightly pixel by pixel, so visual rendering must sit downstream behind a strict one-way tolerance gate.
Key result: 0 Replay Drift Across 3 OSes · 9/9 Suites Pass.
Built-in computer chip counters recorded the energy used.
